terms_modal_description: Review how the site works and how we protect your privacy before accepting.
terms_modal_paragraph_1: This platform provides organized medical learning materials specifically for registered students. When you create an account, we use your basic information like name and email to personalize your experience and offer course recommendations.
terms_modal_paragraph_2: Your privacy is important to us. We keep your personal details secure and do not share your registration information with external parties unless you explicitly authorize it or the law requires it.
terms_modal_paragraph_3: By agreeing, you consent to use your data in ways that improve your learning journey within the platform and accept the rules of the platform and privacy policy described here.
terms_modal_paragraph_4: You can refer back to this policy at any time, and we only use your data to improve your learning experience on the platform, such as reminding you about new lessons or content updates.
